summaries.en: AFFiNE is an open-source knowledge management platform that combines note-taking, task planning, and visual collaboration in one privacy-focused workspace, addressing the need for integrated tools beyond services like Notion and Miro. It leverages CRDT (Conflict-Free Replicated Data Type) technology to enable real-time, offline-capable collaboration without conflicts, ensuring data consistency across devices. Developers can extend its functionality through TypeScript and Rust integrations, while users benefit from customizable blocks, markdown support, and local-first data storage for secure, flexible knowledge organization.
summaries.zh: AFFiNE 是一款开源知识管理平台，将笔记、任务规划和视觉协作整合于一体，注重隐私保护，为用户提供超越 Notion 和 Miro 的集成化工作空间。其核心技术采用 CRDT（无冲突复制数据类型），实现实时、离线的协同编辑，确保多设备间数据一致无冲突。通过 TypeScript 和 Rust 的模块化设计，开发者可轻松定制功能；用户则能利用块编辑器、Markdown 支持和本地优先存储，灵活构建安全的知识库，适用于个人学习、团队项目管理或创意构思等场景。

summaries.en: The Google Cloud generative-ai repository provides practical code samples and Jupyter notebooks for building applications with Google's Gemini models on Vertex AI. It demonstrates how to integrate advanced generative AI capabilities through clear examples covering agents, LangChain integration, and API usage patterns. Developers can use these resources to quickly prototype chatbots, content generation tools, or custom AI workflows while learning best practices for production deployment on Google Cloud infrastructure.
summaries.zh: Google Cloud generative-ai 代码库提供了在 Vertex AI 平台上使用 Gemini 模型构建生成式 AI 应用的实践示例和 Jupyter 笔记本。该项目通过清晰的代码演示了如何集成智能体、LangChain 框架和 API 调用模式，让开发者能够理解大型语言模型的实际应用方法。这些资源可帮助用户快速搭建聊天机器人、内容生成工具或定制化 AI 工作流，同时学习在云端部署生产级 AI 解决方案的技术要点，适合作为探索生成式 AI 开发的起点。

summaries.en: MiroFish is an open-source swarm intelligence engine that tackles complex prediction problems—from financial markets to public opinion—by simulating how decentralized agents collectively solve tasks. Its core innovation lies in modeling multi-agent interactions where simple rules at individual levels produce sophisticated emergent behaviors at the system level, inspired by natural systems like bird flocks. You can apply it to your own forecasting scenarios by configuring agent behaviors and interaction rules in Python, then observing how swarm dynamics generate predictions from distributed intelligence.
summaries.zh: MiroFish是一个开源群体智能引擎，通过模拟去中心化智能体的集体行为，解决金融预测、舆情分析等复杂问题。其技术核心采用多智能体仿真设计，每个智能体遵循简单规则，通过局部交互涌现出系统级预测能力，模仿鸟群、蚁群等自然协作机制。开发者可用Python配置智能体行为和交互规则，应用于自定义场景，观察分布式智能如何通过群体动力学产生洞察，为传统预测方法提供生物启发的替代思路。

summaries.en: Page-Agent is a JavaScript library that enables natural language control of web interfaces, solving the challenge of automating complex browser interactions without writing traditional scripts. It works by embedding an AI agent directly within web pages to interpret user commands and execute corresponding UI actions through programmatic DOM manipulation. Developers can integrate it into testing workflows, build accessible interfaces, or create interactive demos by installing the package and defining natural language instructions for common web tasks.
summaries.zh: Page-Agent是一个JavaScript库，通过自然语言指令直接控制网页界面，解决了传统自动化脚本编写复杂、难以适应动态网页变化的问题。其核心是将AI代理嵌入页面，实时解析用户命令并转换为对DOM的程序化操作，实现点击、输入、导航等交互。该库可用于自动化测试、构建易访问的交互界面，以及创建智能演示工具，帮助非技术用户通过简单描述完成复杂操作。

summaries.en: Jido is an autonomous agent framework for Elixir that enables developers to build distributed AI systems capable of independent decision-making and dynamic workflow orchestration. Its technical strength lies in combining Elixir's functional programming and event-driven architecture to create resilient, concurrent agents that can adapt their behavior in real-time. You can use Jido to implement complex multi-agent scenarios, such as automated customer support pipelines or distributed data processing systems, by defining agent behaviors and communication protocols in a scalable Elixir environment.
summaries.zh: Jido是一个基于Elixir语言的自主体框架，专门用于构建能够独立决策和动态编排工作流的分布式人工智能系统。它巧妙结合了Elixir的函数式编程特性和事件驱动架构，使开发者能够创建高并发、高容错的自主体，这些主体能在运行时根据环境变化调整行为模式。通过定义自主体间的通信协议和行为逻辑，你可以用它实现复杂的多智能体应用场景，比如搭建自动化客服流程或分布式数据处理系统，在保持代码简洁的同时获得强大的扩展能力。

summaries.en: ConvNeXt Base CLIP LAION2B is a vision-language model that bridges images and text by learning joint representations, enabling tasks like zero-shot image classification without task-specific training. Its technical innovation lies in adapting the ConvNeXt architecture—a modern convolutional network design—with CLIP's contrastive learning approach, trained on the large-scale LAION-2B dataset to capture rich visual-semantic alignments. You can use it via Hugging Face's Transformers library for image retrieval, captioning, or as a feature extractor for downstream vision tasks, experimenting with custom prompts to explore its cross-modal understanding.
summaries.zh: ConvNeXt Base CLIP LAION2B 是一个视觉-语言模型，通过联合学习图像和文本的表示，实现了零样本图像分类等任务，无需针对特定任务进行训练。其技术亮点在于将 ConvNeXt 架构——一种现代化的卷积网络设计——与 CLIP 的对比学习方法结合，并在大规模 LAION-2B 数据集上训练，以捕捉丰富的视觉-语义对齐关系。在实际应用中，您可以通过 Hugging Face 的 Transformers 库将其用于图像检索、生成描述，或作为特征提取器支持下游视觉任务，通过自定义提示词来探索其跨模态理解能力，为研究和实验提供灵活工具。

Its technical innovation lies in adapting the ConvNeXt architecture—a modern convolutional network design—with CLIP's contrastive learning approach, trained on the large-scale LAION-2B dataset to capture rich visual-semantic alignments. You can use it via Hugging Face's Transformers library for image retrieval, captioning, or as a feature extractor for downstream vision tasks, experimenting with custom prompts to explore its cross-modal understanding.
